label: Test by Rivals of the fourteen stage-two attribute premises surv for What is altogether IMMUTA (1)
note: Tests the selected premise in the following setting. Same InPotency predicate and primitive Eternal predicate (ETERNAL_1, timeless); one being, one respect. No temporal structure is modelled. Control.immutableInTime in Control.Certificate. Other four premises of StageTwo.GodIsEternal.godIsEternal hold: God is maximal in being, the maximum in being is first, act is simply prior to potency, nothing is in act and potency in the same respect. Its conclusion (God is eternal) fails.
